#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess,json,gzip,base64
commands=[['ip','-4','route','show','table','all'],['ip','-j','link','show','type','xfrm'],['birdc','show','protocols','all','kernel_lab'],['journalctl','-u','bird','-n','35','--no-pager','-o','cat']]
r=[]
for c in commands:
 p=subprocess.run(c,text=True,capture_output=True,timeout=30);r.append(dict(command=c,exitCode=p.returncode,stdout=p.stdout,stderr=p.stderr))
b=base64.b64encode(gzip.compress(json.dumps(r).encode())).decode();assert len(b)<3500;print('DESIGN_SNAPSHOT '+b)
